item.title: Collaborative text editing with RGA
item.author: harisankar.b@niser.ac.in (Harisankar B)
item.description: Notes on a tombstone-free RGA: proved RA-linearizable in Lean 4, then found to reorder your text on delete. Why convergence is not correctness.

item.title: LLM Proposes, Lean Disposes: A Week at the LeanLang Summer School
item.author: harisankar.b@niser.ac.in (Harisankar B)
item.description: In July 2026 I spent a week at IISc Bangalore for the LeanLang Summer School, run by Emergence. Here is how I got there, what Lean actually is, why formally verified autonomy suddenly matters, and a tour of the week.
